title: Encyclopedia of Mathematics (EMS/Springer)
authority_rationale: Editorial board managed by European Mathematical Society; extensive graduate mathematical coverage.
rights_note: Original Springer entries are copyrighted; later contributions generally CC BY-SA/GFDL; individual page lineage must be inspected before excerpt reuse.
acquisition_policy: Index/locator metadata only; no bulk copying.

title: PlanetMath encyclopedia
authority_rationale: Nonprofit collaboratively edited mathematical encyclopedia with subject/alphabetical indices; individual contributions need review.
acquisition_policy: Attribution and share-alike apply; respect robots and site performance.

title: The Stacks Project
authority_rationale: Collaborative expert-maintained comprehensive algebraic geometry reference with structured chapters and tags.
rights_note: Contributions use GNU Free Documentation License; avoid excerpts absent item-specific compliance assessment.
acquisition_policy: Index and section locators only initially; verify crawler rules before network intake.

title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1
authority_rationale: Rice University OpenStax editorially developed textbook with usable index for introductory college mathematics.
rights_note: Noncommercial and share-alike limits; project licensing compatibility unconfirmed, so locator-only.

title: ProofWiki
authority_rationale: Community-maintained proof and definition wiki, cross-check mathematics independently due to variable editorial quality.
rights_note: Text pages licensed; check attribution, excluded discussion/user pages and crawl restrictions.

title: MIT OpenCourseWare mathematics courses
authority_rationale: University-authored course notes spanning undergraduate and advanced mathematics; heterogeneous index accessibility.
rights_note: Noncommercial and share-alike reuse obligations; record only references until compatibility assessed.

title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions
authority_rationale: NIST curated technical reference in special functions and applied analysis.
rights_note: NIST explicitly prohibits bulk copying or redistribution and commercial copying; restricted to citation/locator research.
acquisition_policy: No automated bulk scraping or copied text.

title: Wolfram MathWorld
authority_rationale: Specialist mathematics encyclopedia with wide topic coverage; editorially managed.
rights_note: Bulk copying/mirroring and robotic archival copying prohibited; limited scholarly reading/citation only.
acquisition_policy: Do not run bulk index intake or archive with robots.

title: AMS MathSciNet / Mathematical Reviews
authority_rationale: American Mathematical Society scholarly bibliographic database; expert reviews and literature mapping.
rights_note: Subscription-based. Catalog for authority awareness only; do not obtain, scrape, or bypass access.
acquisition_policy: Excluded from Wave 1 intake unless publicly accessible metadata explicitly permitted.
